summary: Verified HeyGen video overlay support in client-side video export. Backend POST /api/course/{project_id}/export-video-frames returns videoElements array for slides with HeyGen videos. Backend GET /api/proxy-video proxies HeyGen videos with correct content-type and CORS headers. Frontend video export generates WebM with HeyGen overlay using requestAnimationFrame continuous redraw. All 15 backend tests passed. SCORM and HTML exports still work (regression verified).

minor.issue: Whitelist uses endswith() check which allows domains like 'not-heygen.ai' to pass because it ends with 'heygen.ai'. Consider using exact match or subdomain validation.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Improve proxy-video whitelist to use exact match or proper subdomain validation instead of endswith()
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: Backend export-video-frames endpoint returns videoElements array with src, x, y, width, height for HeyGen videos
GOOD: Video element coordinates are scaled to canvas size (1280x720) with proper offset calculation
GOOD: Proxy endpoint returns correct content-type (video/webm) and CORS headers (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *)
GOOD: Frontend clientVideoExport.js uses requestAnimationFrame loop for continuous canvas redraw at ~60fps
GOOD: AudioContext mixes HeyGen video audio into the recording stream
GOOD: Video export with HeyGen overlay completed in ~60s for 13 slides
GOOD: Video export without HeyGen completed in ~40s for 10 slides
GOOD: Progress bar shows slide-by-slide progress during video generation
context_for_next_testing_agent: HeyGen video overlay support verified. Two test projects: 1) 2e180a28-cde8-4a43-be51-1a845effe787 (13 slides, HeyGen video on slide 0) 2) cb4e0112-3e45-44fe-ab29-304b0ef8f0a0 (10 slides, no video elements). Backend returns videoElements array with position/size for HeyGen videos. Frontend uses requestAnimationFrame + Canvas.captureStream(30) + MediaRecorder for WebM generation. HeyGen videos are proxied through /api/proxy-video to bypass CORS.
